messages:
elaine: Hey folks — quick nudge on the PM follow-up for the 3/12 outage. I pulled the postmortem and there are 4 items still listed as 'in progress' and two of those are past their target dates. @raj, you're the owner for the KV cache eviction change and the rollout checklist. Can you give a status update?
raj: Sorry — got pulled into infra work yesterday. KV change is implemented in branch 'kv-evict-v2' and unit tests are green. Need to run a canary deploy and validate latencies. Targeting canary this afternoon.
elaine: Thanks. Can you add the canary command and expected validation steps to the ticket so QA can pick it up if you're OOO?
sophia: @raj if you want I can run the canary validation steps today after standup. I have the perf harness ready.
raj: @sophia that would be awesome. I'll push the branch now and add the checklist. cc @ben for rollout approval.
ben: Reviewing the checklist now. Two quick items: (1) verify 99th latency with the KV prefix enabled, (2) ensure fallback policy works when eviction triggers. If both pass I'm +1 for gradual rollout.
oncall-bot: Reminder: Incident 2026-03-12 postmortem action 'kv-evict rollout' is overdue by 3 days. Owner: raj.
elaine: @ops-manager can you confirm whether we want to require a canary window of 1 hour or 4 hours for this change? Last incident suggested we needed longer windows.
ops-manager: Given previous flapping, make it 4 hours and require a manual checkpoint in the ticket with the observed metrics. I'll go ahead and update the SLO play.
raj: Canary started at 15:10 UTC. Initial metrics look fine — 99th latency unchanged. Posting logs to the ticket. Will leave canary running for 4 hours.
sophia: Ran the perf harness — KV eviction exercise shows stable tails. Uploaded artifacts to the ticket as well.
elaine: Great. Once canary finishes, please paste the final numbers and mark the action item as 'validation complete' + add closure PR link.
ben: FYI I also added an ops-runbook snippet to the PR describing how to disable eviction if something regresses.
raj: Will do. ETA to mark closed: EOD today unless we see regressions.
elaine: Perfect. One more ask — there are two recurring pattern items flagged in the postmortem about prefix cache churn. Can we put a 2-week spike on the calendar to investigate root cause? @sophia to lead?
sophia: Happy to lead the spike. I'll schedule 4 sessions over the next two weeks and invite infra + perf.
elaine: Thanks all. I'll follow up in 48 hours if anything is still open. :white_check_mark:
raj: Appreciated.
ben: :thumbsup:
